name: nft-marketplace
description: Local NFT marketplace pattern that installs the NFT contract pack and runs PixelSnek against an indexed node.
use_case: Run the xian-nft product under known XSC-0005 contract names so wallets and the PixelSnek web app can discover, mint, list, and trade NFTs.

starter_flows.name: local
starter_flows.summary: Run a local indexed node, install the NFT contract pack, and start PixelSnek.

steps.title: Create and start the local indexed node
notes: Run these commands from the xian-stack checkout.
The base localnet starts without NFT product contracts. Install the contract pack next.

steps.title: Install the NFT contract pack
commands: uv run xian contract-pack install nft --recipe reference-marketplace --repo-dir ../xian-nft
notes: Run this command from the xian-cli checkout.
This deploys the pinned XSC-0005 checker and reference collection through the xian-nft bootstrap script.

steps.title: Start PixelSnek
notes: Run these commands from the xian-nft checkout.
Point PixelSnek at the local node RPC if you are not using the default endpoint.
